text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After putting on a brilliant performance, 
Copano Rickey was convinced dirt was her 
calling. However, it was also true that 
dirt races received less attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To spread Feng Shui along the dirt route, 
getting people excited about dirt racing 
itself is essential. To that end...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All she needed to do was run in the 
Japanese Derby and draw the turf fans over 
to dirt. That was the major option that 
had now presented itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That being said, dirt races are the main 
priority. Setting the Champions Cup as the 
next goal, she aims to show the power of 
Feng Shui in the match against Hokko 
Tarumae.
